item.title: China, ASEAN countries struggle over South China Sea code of conduct
item.description: The Philippines wanted a South China Sea code of conduct in place by 2026. But persistent disagreements between China and ASEAN countries are slowing progress toward a deal.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Dozens missing as deadly fire hits Indonesian candy factory
item.description: At least three people were killed in a devastating fire at a confectionery factory on Java. Officials said many more people remain unaccounted for, prompting fears of a much larger tragedy.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: Mexican special forces arrest drug kingpin 'Chapo Isidro'
item.description: The alleged leader of the Beltran Leyva gang and one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives, known as "Chapo Isidro," was captured by the Mexican military following a raid and a shootout in the coastal state of Sinaloa.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Russian helicopter suspected of violating Finnish airspace
item.description: Finland's Defense Ministry thinks the incursion is linked to a drone strike earlier Saturday on a Russian cargo ship, which is on a US sanctions list.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: EU and Indonesia sign trade deal
item.description: A deal covering 730 million people promises lower tariffs and new investment opportunities as the European Union seeks to diversify trade ties amid growing global economic tensions.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: New EU budget proposal aims at tax gobal tech giants
item.description: European Council President Antonio Costa has proposed a smaller EU budget for 2028-2034, including a 3% tax on major digital firms to ease member states' contributions. France has already rejected the plan as inadequate.
